topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.7)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk each quarter; board audit committee oversees internal audit
Group CISO, division security and compliance leads, and service line owners with defined reporting lines (POL-01)
Role-based hiring requirements, training, and annual reviews for engineering and operations staff
Control owners named in the common control catalog and the service line control matrix; performance goals include security duties
FMS component inventory, data flow diagram (utility push to FMS ingestion, one-way), and logs

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies, supplements, and security responsibilities communicated at hire and every year
Written service commitments and a system description for subscribers
gap: No system description; subscription agreements state no security, availability, or notice commitments
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; add notice terms to the subscription agreement at renewal

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives and commitments drive the division risk register
SP 800-30 risk analysis each year with roll-up to group (POL-01 4.3)
Fraud risk considered in the group ERM and internal audit plans
Changes to the FMS and the asset-health models (AI-003) assessed for risk before release
gap: Model updates to AI-003 were released without a documented risk review until 2026-08
remediation: Route AI-003 model releases through the Group AI Standard change gate (P10)

control_description: Separate evaluation of FMS-specific controls
gap: The 2026 P07 sample did not include FMS-specific controls; common controls were assessed
remediation: Add tenant isolation, change, and backup tests for the FMS to the 2027 internal audit plan

control_description: Findings tracked in the POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 High baseline and the common control catalog
Technology general controls: identity, change, operations, and backup provided as group common controls

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies POL-01 to POL-05 and the division supplement deploy the controls

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Tenant isolation enforced in the application and the database
gap: Isolation tests are manual and not run every release (P01 MF-010)
remediation: Automated cross-tenant tests in every release (Manufacturing supplement)

control_description: Joiner-mover-leaver process from the HR system; access removed within 4 hours of termination
Role-based access approved by the service line owner and certified each quarter
Physical security of data centers inherited from cloud provider B (carved out)
Media sanitization in provider data centers (carved out); laptops wiped with certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Landing-zone network controls and web application firewall; deny by default

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encryption in transit and at rest; data loss prevention on managed devices
evidence: TLS scan; key settings (P07 SC-8, SC-28)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on servers and endpoints; allowlisting on build agents

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and configuration monitoring of cloud workloads (P07 RA-5, CM-6)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Application-level monitoring of subscriber data access
gap: Cloud and platform logs reach the SIEM; FMS application logs of cross-tenant queries do not
remediation: Onboard FMS application access logs with cross-tenant alert rules

control_description: SOC triage and severity rules (POL-03)
FMS incident steps, including subscriber notices
gap: The group runbook covers FMS technically, but subscriber notice terms and contacts are not defined
remediation: Add FMS subscriber contacts and the new notice term to the matrix after CC2.3

control_description: Recovery runbooks and immutable backups in provider B
Change authorization, testing, and approval in the FMS deployment pipeline
gap: Application changes are gated; model and configuration changes for AI-003 were not until 2026-08
remediation: Same gate for model and configuration changes (with CC3.4)

control_description: Business continuity plans and cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Supplier review and contract terms (POL-01 4.8); provider B SOC 2 report reviewed every year
Capacity monitoring and autoscaling in provider B; ingestion queues sized for storm-season data volumes
Backups to the immutable vault; warm standby region; environmental protections inherited from provider B
gap: No availability or recovery objective has been committed to subscribers; the BIA sets an internal RTO of 8 hours (P05 BP-MF09)
remediation: State the availability commitment and RTO in the service commitments

control_description: Recovery plan testing for the FMS
gap: The warm standby region has never been failed over in a test
remediation: Fail over to the standby region in a test and record results against the 8-hour RTO

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Subscriber asset data classified Confidential (POL-04); encrypted; access limited by tenant
Disposal of subscriber data at contract end
gap: No documented deletion procedure or certificate for departing subscribers
remediation: Deletion procedure with certificate within 60 days of termination
